title: Invertibility of the normalized sectionwise scalar map
statement: For every scheme T, fixed model m, and normalized natural transformation o as above, each component o.app M is an isomorphism.

source.place: Stacks 03EK and 06YY, scalar-extension generators detect isomorphisms

proof.text: The sheafified pure tensors 1 tensor m generate change of rings; the normalized formula identifies the map with the canonical extension map, whose inverse is induced by restriction of scalars.

mathlib_searches.query: change of rings generator detects isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration gives this normalized componentwise isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_section_ordinary_normalized_isIso (T : Scheme.{u})
    (model : SectionModel a T)
    (ordinary : QuotientChange.extension a T ⋙
        (equivalence Λ' T).functor ⟶
      (equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E)
    (hordinary : ∀ (M : Modules Λ T) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (m : M.X.obj.obj W),
      (((ordinary.app M) ≫ eqToHom (model.obj_eq _)).val.app W)
          (((Mod.extendUnit (ProEtale.coefficientMap a T) M).hom.hom.app W) m) =
        (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf (sectionQuotient a T)
            ((equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M)).presheaf).app W
              ((1 : (ring Λ' T).obj.obj W)
                ⊗ₜ[(ring Λ T).obj.obj W,((sectionQuotient a T).hom.app W).hom] m)) :
    ∀ M : Modules Λ T, IsIso (ordinary.app M)
